outside.title: A fixed home-wide Bun link cannot preserve per-project runtime ownership
outside.resolution: Replace A2's mutable fixed-version global link with project-aware launching; bind install verdicts to the calling project and resolved runtime, reconcile pregate's separate resolver, and exercise alternating exact-pin projects plus unrelated Bun commands.

native.title: Fourth install-honesty wave in about two weeks: add a single verdict owner and a pre-merge fresh-machine acceptance job instead of a post-ship manual rerun
native.resolution: Route install, upgrade, repair and session-start through one final step: gstack-capy-install --check from ORIG_PWD, printing only its trailer. Make the GBRA-60 reproduction (image Bun on PATH, verified Bun off PATH, project pinned to 1.4.3, fresh shells) an automated job on a fresh Capy or Ubicloud machine that gates Lane A's merge.

outside.title: The revised failure trailer has conflicting shapes and an unspecified pins exit code
outside.resolution: Define one backward-compatible status grammar with failed-component information, specify A7's numeric pins-readiness exit and partial-upgrade state, and synchronize text/JSON/verdict/docs with success and multi-failure note-composition tests.

native.title: A9's trailer grammar would replace the existing 'gstack: fail <components>' head that the Capy skill (and its lagging Drive copies) dispatch repairs on
native.resolution: Scope the grammar to `gstack: ok <rev> for=<skill>[ (<notes>)]`. Keep failures as `gstack: fail <component>[,<component>] — <detail>; fix: <cmd> (<CODE>; <url>#<anchor>)`, with notes appended in the same fixed order. Add a test that runs the current capy/skill/gstack/SKILL.md dispatch examples (fail revision, fail runtime,pins, fail pins) against the new output.

outside.title: Recommendation edits can change a displayed gate's defaults without invalidating its reply
outside.resolution: Version semantic recommendation changes, reject old replies, and refresh plan-approval summaries, decisions and artifact hashes; return the new gate identity and test concurrent/repeated edits, answered/carried choices and restore.

native.title: The new recommend verb can change what rec resolves to after the owner has seen the gate
native.resolution: Hash the rendered recommendations into the relay (for example rec_hash in the render's resolution line). Make answer reject a rec whose hash no longer matches (re-render and re-relay). Make recommend refuse after a render has been relayed unless it bumps to a fresh render. Test recommend-after-relay, then rec.
